rows.en:
Hino pulled out a knife.
I probably didn't even have the strength left to dodge.
...No, that was no good.
I wasn't going to give up over something like this.
If he stabbed me, I'd take him down with me.
I timed my breathing.
Hino raised the knife high and came at me.
Ready to sacrifice an arm, I tried to lunge at him.
Just then, with a rumbling crash, the wall came tumbling down.{p}

"Aaagh!"
I dodged just in time, but Hino was crushed under the rubble.
"H-Hino!"
Hino lay with his lower body pinned under the wall.
Blood trickled from his lips.
"My... Murder Club...... of the chosen ones..."
His voice broke off.
Was he dead?
I tried to get closer.
But the walls were starting to collapse again.
At this rate, I'd be buried alive too!
Planting my unsteady feet, I fled the old school building.{p}

The night air was cold and delicious.
All the tension drained out of me at once, and I sank to the ground in the schoolyard.{p}

Against the dark night sky, the flames blazed bright red in a mad, wild feast.
It's beautiful... I thought.{p}

As I sat there in a daze, I heard the wail of sirens.
Probably a fire engine one of the neighbors had called.
That sound should have been shrill, but right now it was soothing to me.
I was alive.
I was really alive.{p}

Once I knew I'd made it, the fear suddenly swelled.
This was the old school building in the dead of night.
Waiting here until morning was far too frightening to even consider.
I picked up the flashlight that had been flung aside and stood up.
Then, without really thinking, my eyes fell on a broken window frame.{p}

Rotten, crumbling wood.
But it still looked at least a little sturdy.
An idea came to me.
...This might come in handy.
I picked up the broken window frame.
Maybe that really was a warning from God.{p}

...I felt dizzy.
Exhaustion crashed down on me all at once.
Still, I couldn't believe how much I'd managed to do.
I was impressed by my own stamina.
Staggering, I slowly put one leaden leg in front of the other.{p}

Going down the stairs was agony.
With every step, I felt like my foot was about to slip.
There was no strength left in my legs at all.
By the time I finally made it down to the first floor, the sky was about to start turning pale.{p}

"Not bad at all."
Hino grinned at me.
"You've been so entertaining that I came up with another game."
A game?
Just hearing Hino's words made me sick to my stomach.
What more did he want to make me do?{p}

Just then, Kazama stepped forward.
He looked pale.{p}

"Kazama here swallowed one of those poison capsules a little while ago.
I told him he doesn't get the antidote unless he kills you."
"What★"
I couldn't believe my ears.
Weren't these guys on the same side?
And yet he'd turned him into a prop for his game.
Hino laughed.
"Go on, Kazama. If you don't hurry, the poison's going to spread."{p}

rows.en:
As if spurred on by that, Kazama stepped even closer.
His eyes were brimming with murderous intent.
He meant it!
The instant I realized it, Kazama lunged at me.{p}
I dodged on reflex and grabbed his arm.{p}What should I do?
Try to talk him down
Break his arm
I bore down on his arm with all my strength.{p}

I was blacking out.
Kazama pounded me over and over where I lay.
At this rate, he'd beat me to death.
...But I couldn't fight back.
Too much had happened tonight. Far too much.
I couldn't move anymore...
I was losing all feeling.{p}
Just then, as I lay sprawled on the earth, the light of dawn shone down on me.{p}

Kazama's expression changed.
He knitted his brows in anguish.
Maybe I could talk him around after all.
That gave me strength.
"Listen, Kazama..."{p}

"Raaaaagh☆"
Before I could finish, Kazama suddenly tackled me.
Caught off guard, I went down.
Tangled together, we rolled across the ground.{p}

Kazama raised an ice pick.
Was he going to stab me★
I wasn't going to let him.
I tried to wrench the ice pick away from Kazama.
As we grappled, the point slipped.{p}

"Ah!"
Kazama's body went rigid.
The ice pick was buried deep in his chest.
Still glaring at me, Kazama slowly slid down into a heap.{p}

"Tch. Useless."
Hino spat out the words.
I couldn't believe it.
What kind of person was he?
One of his own had just died, and...
Seeing the look on my face, Hino twisted his lips into a sneer.{p}

"What, got a problem with that?"
A knife appeared from his pocket.
"If you do, why don't you come at me★"
So now he was going to threaten me with a weapon?
He was filthy right down to the core.
Him, I could never forgive!
I slammed my body into Hino.{p}

"Whoa★"
Hino went flying.
He must never have imagined I wouldn't be afraid of his knife.
"How dare you..."
A savage light burned in his eyes.
The eyes of a beast that tears everything apart.
This must have been Hino's true nature.
Hino slowly tried to get to his feet.
Just then, someone grabbed Hino's leg.{p}

It was Kazama, who had been lying on the ground.
"L... Lord Hino... the ampoule..."{p}

Kazama's eyes blazed with rage.
"But... you're abandoning me?"{p}

"Yeah. I've got no use for losers, you see."
Hino turned back to me.
"Now, {a}, it's your turn."
But I couldn't answer.
My eyes were fixed on what was behind Hino.{p}
The moment I shouted, Kazama brought the ice pick down.{p}

"Gyaaaaaaaaah☆"
Hino's scream echoed all around.{p}

"Now... now I'll be all... ri... ght..."
With a satisfied smile, Kazama breathed his last, too.
I sank limply to the ground.
I couldn't take another step.
I just wanted to fall asleep right there.
Was it over now...?
Was it really over...?
Just then, as if in answer to my question, the first light of morning came streaming in.{p}

...The faculty room!
I had to get to the faculty room first, or I wouldn't be able to go anywhere.{p}

I reached the faculty room.
...Thank goodness.
Luckily, the faculty room wasn't locked.
The lights were off, too.{p}

I slipped into the faculty room.
There was no time.
Whatever I did, I couldn't afford to take it slow.{p}What should I do?
I reached the faculty room.{p}Now, what should I do?
I searched the desks once more.{p}

Searching so many desks over and over was hard work.
If nothing turned up this time, it would all be a complete waste of effort.
...But I didn't find anything.{p}What should I do next?

I stood in front of the bulletin board.
I didn't think there was anything here, after all.{p}What should I do?
I slowly put the receiver back.{p}
What should I do?

That's it!
There should be a teacher on duty in the night-duty room!
I didn't know which teacher it would be, but I'd go and see.
If I explained the situation, maybe something could be done?
...Or would I just get chewed out?
It was all or nothing. I'd go and see!{p}
The door was locked.{p}

"Excuse me! Excuse me! Please! Open the door!"
...There was no answer.
Were they out making the rounds right now?
I didn't have a key to open this door.{p}
Where should I go?

The night-duty room door was locked.
I didn't have a key to open this door.{p}
Where should I go?
I made it to the night-duty room.{p}

It was still locked, same as before.
Even though the lights inside were blazing.{p}
I came to the night-duty room.{p}
I tried going to the night-duty room once more.{p}

Beside the teacher, who lay limp on the floor, was Shindo, tied up...
Oh my God!
Shindo was lying face down.
And yet his face alone was looking up at the ceiling.
In other words, his neck had been twisted a hundred and eighty degrees, so that his face was on his back.
One look at his wide-open, staring eyes, and it was clear he was dead.
Next to his head, there was writing in blood.
The incompetent don't even deserve to live.
I stifled a scream.{p}
Whoever killed Shindo might still be lurking somewhere nearby.{p}What should I do?

I came to the night-duty room again.
I did my best not to look at the corpses lying in the middle of the room.{p}Now, what should I do?

"Teacher, something terrible's happened!"
I ran over to the teacher.
When I touched the teacher's shoulder, the head lolled to one side.
The body toppled right over.
Across the throat was a single straight gash!{p}

"Aaaagh!"
I screamed.{p}

At that very moment, something hot slammed into my back with a thud.
What...?{p}

I turned around, and there was Shindo, his eyes wild with fury.
In his hand he gripped a blood-soaked knife.
Blood...?
I put my hand to my back.
It was slick.
This was...
My palm was smeared bright red.
The strength suddenly drained out of my body.
Shindo was laughing.
Was I going to die?
I...{p}

A warm darkness enveloped me.
I couldn't see anything anymore.{p}

Something was wrong.
The teacher was right there inside, and yet there was no answer.
...Could something have happened?
I looked around the room without thinking.
There was nowhere in this room for anyone to hide.
I called out once more.
"...Teacher?"
But still no answer came back.
I ran over and put my hand on the teacher's shoulder.
And then...
The teacher slumped over, just like that.
"Whoa!"
The teacher's throat had been slashed straight across.
...Dead!
"Diiiiiiie!"
Suddenly, a voice rang out.{p}

I turned around, and Shindo was lunging at me from the doorway.
He had a knife in his hand.
"Whoa!"
I dodged by a hair.
The knife grazed my cheek.
It burned!
I pulled out the saw I'd tucked in at my hip.{p}

Something was wrong.
The teacher was right there inside, and yet there was no answer.
...Could something have happened?
I looked around the room without thinking.
There was nowhere in this room for anyone to hide.
I called out once more.
"...Teacher?"
But still no answer came back.
I ran over and put my hand on the teacher's shoulder.
And then...
The teacher slumped over, just like that.
"Whoa!"
The teacher's throat had been slashed straight across.
...Dead!
"Diiiiiiie!"
Suddenly, a voice rang out.{p}

I turned around, and Shindo was lunging at me from the doorway.
He had a knife in his hand.
"Whoa!"
I dodged by a hair.
The knife grazed my cheek.
It burned!{p}

I steeled myself and lunged in close.
I rammed headfirst into Shindo's stomach.{p}

"...I'm sorry. I don't want to fight you."
Shindo gave me a suspicious look.
"Huh. You got real tame all of a sudden."
"All I want is the ampoule.
Please, I'm begging you, tell me where it is."
I meekly bowed my head.{p}

Shindo lowered his knife.
"Hmm... If you're gonna go that far, I might think about it.
But only if you become my lackey."{p}What should I do?
Refuse
Agree to be his lackey

"Good. Then I'll tell you."
Shindo grinned, satisfied.
"But it'd be bad if Hino heard. Lend me your ear."
Doing as I was told, I leaned my ear toward Shindo.{p}

Shindo was laughing, enjoying himself.
"What an idiot. There's no point making someone like you my lackey."
So I'd been tricked.
It was so... galling.
Blood spraying from my neck, I slowly crumpled to the floor.{p}

"No way! I won't do it!"
I shouted.{p}

"What did you say?"
Shindo started to raise his knife.{p}

I looked for a way out.
...It's no good.
The night-duty room's windows have bars over them.
There's no gap a person could ever fit through.
The only door is behind Shindo.
There's no way I can escape!{p}What will you do?

I pressed the knife against Shindo.
Shindo's face went pale.
"Wh... what are you gonna do to me?"
His voice was hoarse with fear.
I deliberately didn't answer him.
Let him get more and more scared.
Then maybe he'd understand a little of how I felt.{p}
All right, I'll let Shindo go.{p}
I climbed off Shindo.{p}
That instant, Shindo punched me and sent me flying.{p}
Sparks burst before my eyes.{p}

...When I came to, Shindo was sitting astride me.
The exact reverse of a moment ago.
Shindo's eyes glinted cruelly.
"So long, {a}."{p}
The moment he said it, my throat was slashed straight across.{p}

I yanked the TV cord out.
With Shindo pinned down, I tied his hands behind his back.{p}

I looked at the sink.
An empty cup noodle container had been left there.{p}Was it the murdered teacher's last supper?

I opened the closet.
There was one set of futon bedding, and nothing else.{p}Should I pull the futon out too, just in case?
Do it, just in case
No need to go that far
Eh, I don't need to go that far.

I dragged the futon out of the closet.
Better safe than sorry.
...But in the end, there was nothing.{p}I shoved the futon roughly back inside.
I searched the shelves.{p}Just as I thought, the ampoule doesn't seem to be here.
Which floor's classrooms should I go to?

Second-floor classrooms
Third-floor classrooms
Fourth-floor classrooms
Search elsewhere
Where should I search?
The new school building had seven classrooms on each floor.{p}
Which classroom should I go to?
Far left
Second from left

Desks and chairs stood in neat rows.
Seeing it like this, it's hard to believe students use it during the day.
The classroom feels colder than usual, too.
Anyway, I have to search.
First, I check the teacher's platform.
...Nothing.
Next, I check the desks.
Of course, I search thoroughly inside them too.
...Nothing.
I search every corner of the room.
It doesn't look like it's in this classroom.{p}

Don't bring stuff like this to school!
Taking my frustration out on it, I put the bottle back.
Other than that, there's nothing out of the ordinary.

Could it be a love letter?{p}Should I take a little peek?
Take a look
I don't want to look

No, that would be in poor taste.
Besides, I don't have time for that.{p}
Where should I go?

I tore the letter open.
With a dry rustle, I unfolded the notepaper.
Let's see, what does it say...
"Whoever reads this letter will die within twenty-four hours," it says★
"If you don't want to die, write three letters with the same words and send them out..."
A chain letter of doom.
Now, of all times.
It felt like my bad luck had just come crashing down on me even harder.
I wish I hadn't looked...
I put the letter back.{p}
